Piolo Pascual, James Reid Mark the Start of the Yuletide Season
at Robinsons Malls Tree Lighting Events

The lighting of the Christmas tree is a long-cherished tradition in every home—and of course, at Robinsons Malls! But this year’s tree lighting events certainly won’t be like any other, because two of the biggest showbiz stars are coming over to join excited mall goers in this truly unique and heartwarming celebration.

Consider this your pre-Christmas treat and mark your calendars now: Celebrity heartthrobs Piolo Pascual and James Reid will be making their special appearance at this year’s major lighting events at Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Place Manila!

On November 3 at 6 p.m., prepare to be swept off your feet as James leads the Christmas tree lighting event at Robinsons Place Manila. With a fun, comical circus theme, the gigantic 36-feet Christmas tree at Robinsons Place Manila will surely bring smiles to shoppers young and old alike.

To make this event even more memorable, James will also render an unforgettable musical performance for fans, and join a gift-giving activity with children from the Philippine General Hospital Cancer Ward, who are being treated to a fun day at the mall.

James Reid is set to warm your hearts with a musical performance and a gift-giving activity with cancer-afflicted children at the Christmas tree lighting event at Robinsons Place Manila on November 3.

On November 11 at 6 p.m., it’s Piolo’s turn to turn up the heat—and turn on the Christmas lights—at Robinsons Magnolia! The singer-actor is set to serenade mall goers with the most soulful tunes—definitely a must-see! Piolo will also be joining the lighting of the enchanted, 36-foot tall Christmas tree with a rainbow of colors and a bevy of beautiful, winged creatures.

Children supported by the Immaculate Concepcion Cathedral will be treated to a trip to the mall on the same day, and their visit will be capped off by a gift-giving activity led by no less than Piolo himself.

Piolo Pascual makes the holidays extra-special for mall goers with a soulful performance and a gift-giving activity with children beneficiaries at the Christmas tree lighting event at Robinsons Magnolia on November 11.
Catch these truly special, star-studded Christmas tree lighting events at Robinsons Malls this November!

DATE MALL CELEBRITY GUEST
November 3, 2018 Robinsons Place Manila James Reid
November 11, 2018 Robinsons Magnolia Piolo Pascual
All tree lighting events start at 6 p.m.
